summary: Xometry, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 2,647,059 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $85.00 per share, with gross proceeds of $225 million to the company. The shares are offered on a firm-commitment basis via J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, William Blair, Citizens, Cantor, and Craig-Hallum. This is a standard equity capital raise, not a special-situation event. No special-situation classification applies.
